summary: Found 6 new roles this run: 3 games & tech, 3 operations. Search was thin. 3 tailored resume drafts ready.

items.title: Service Desk Specialist
items.note: Remote ticket-based first-line support with documentation duties; associate's degree or equivalent experience accepted. Wants 1+ year of service desk experience.

items.title: SMB Customer Onboarding Specialist
items.note: Fully remote SaaS onboarding and training role with cross-team coordination; no degree listed. Stretch: wants prior onboarding experience.

items.title: Project Coordinator
items.note: Remote coordination of multi-site tech rollouts with tracking tools, $55-66k contract; no degree listed. Stretch: 2+ years coordination.

items.title: Operations Supervisor
items.note: Supervises a high-volume kitchen team with inventory and waste duties, $70k, high school diploma required, short train ride. Closes 10/31.

items.title: Assistant General Manager
items.note: Store-management path with staffing, training and shrink control, $25.80-35/hr, high school diploma, short train commute.

items.title: Assistant Manager - Restaurant
items.note: Restaurant assistant management with inventory control and scheduling, $60-65k, no degree listed. Stretch: wants prior restaurant management.
